body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the August meeting. Please keep the streetlight upgrade in the budget. Many of us on Willow Avenue use it every week.

articles.title: Joseph Hallinan, 93, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Joseph Hallinan for the many years of service to Canal Park.
body: Joseph Hallinan died in June at home on Elm Avenue, at the age of 93. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Canal Park.

Born in Canal Park in the years after the war, Joseph Hallinan spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Millrace Youth Center in his or her name.
